up: Return the first 1000 activity rows for target CHEMBL1293265. Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Source activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1293265', standard type 'IC50', standard relation '=', and pChEMBL value not null. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending and assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
INNER JOIN assays a
  ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary td
  ON a.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md
  ON act.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs
  ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293265'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
